**2. Peter Zetterberg (Microsoft/Xbox) — waiting on your email since 16 Sep** · [LinkedIn 124](/open/124)

Alex Hope (recruiter, Python role in Gothenburg) · Saurabh Khire + Ali Amjad (hackathon thanks, a 👍 clears them) · missed WhatsApp calls from Seyvik/Yannick · CookUnity spam · OTP codes · CI failure mails · Hostinger payment failed + Railway trial (admin, not people).
